character.camera: third-person gameplay camera about 3.5-4 m behind and 2 m above the player; player full body at roughly 25-55 percent of frame height
character.skeleton: Epic UE5 Mannequin skeleton (SK_Mannequin, as used by SKM_Manny_Simple), same bone names and hierarchy, shared by every player part (head, hair, outfits)
character.poseRequirements: A-pose bind pose; plays the prototype's ABP_Player locomotion (idle, walk, jog) with foot IK; head look on neck_01, neck_02 and head up to 80 degrees; two-bone arm IK reaching in front, across and overhead; finger curl from open flat to fist on index, middle, ring, pinky and thumb joints; deep crouch and seated

player-base.camera: third-person gameplay camera about 3.5-4 m behind and 2 m above the player; player full body at roughly 25-55 percent of frame height
player-base.skeleton: Epic UE5 Mannequin skeleton (SK_Mannequin, as used by SKM_Manny_Simple), same bone names and hierarchy, shared by every player part (head, hair, outfits)
player-base.poseRequirements: A-pose bind pose; plays the prototype's ABP_Player locomotion (idle, walk, jog) with foot IK; head look on neck_01, neck_02 and head up to 80 degrees; two-bone arm IK reaching in front, across and overhead; finger curl from open flat to fist on index, middle, ring, pinky and thumb joints; deep crouch and seated

prop.camera: third-person, about 3.5-4 m behind and 2 m above the player, 75 degree FOV

npc.camera: third-person gameplay camera about 3.5-4 m behind and 2 m above the player; player full body at roughly 25-55 percent of frame height
npc.skeleton: Epic UE5 Mannequin skeleton (SK_Mannequin): Manny's bone names, hierarchy, orientations and A-pose with the character's own bone lengths, shared by every piece of that character
npc.poseRequirements: A-pose bind pose; plays the prototype's ABP_Player locomotion (idle, walk) with foot IK; head look on neck_01, neck_02 and head; the NPC perform gestures (offer hand, raise a glass to the face, point, cover head, flinch, hold a tray on the right palm); finger curl from open flat to fist on index, middle, ring, pinky and thumb joints; grabbed by hand, forearm and head, knocked over and ragdolled

set-piece.camera: third-person, about 3.5-4 m behind and 2 m above the player, 75 degree FOV; set pieces stand 15 to 25 m away at the set's edges
